summary: The fixed-budget real-CoinRun PPO run is active on one A10. Two zero-update JAX compatibility failures were retained and fixed with regression tests before the current clean execution source was launched.

observations.name: cpu_test_status
observations.observed: Core PPO, Gym3 alignment, checkpoint, collection-boundary and dataset-audit tests pass on CPU; the full branch suite has 97 passing tests.

observations.name: runtime_preflight
observations.observed: Python 3.10.12, Procgen 0.10.7 and JAX 0.4.35 passed the fixed CPU action/model smoke. The same environment saw cuda:0 and produced actor logits shape [1,15] and values shape [1].

observations.name: active_run
observations.observed: Attempt 8303d788-8966-4850-86a2-d87bc9a47366 entered RUNNING under PID 81218 with max_steps=1536 and W&B offline; it reached 8 completed updates / 131,072 transitions while the PID remained alive.

deviations.reason: JAX 0.4.35 imports nvidia.cuda_nvcc.__file__, while the unconstrained CUDA 12.9 nvcc wheel exposes a namespace package with __file__=None.
deviations.change: Pinned nvidia-cuda-nvcc-cu12 to 12.4.131 and added a regression test before rerunning the preflight.

deviations.reason: The shared logger called jax.distributed.is_initialized(), which is absent in the frozen JAX 0.4.35 API.
deviations.change: Used the already-established optional-API pattern from dreamer.parallel, added a regression test, and relaunched from a clean detached worktree.

failures.message: JAX 0.4.35 received nvidia.cuda_nvcc.__file__=None from the unbounded CUDA 12.9 namespace package.
jax.distributed has no attribute is_initialized under JAX 0.4.35.

observed: The runtime preflight passed on CPU and on the A10 with the exact 15-action actor interface.
The active run has a durable run ID and attempt ID, and its structured state is RUNNING.
Both retained compatibility failures occurred before the first PPO update.
not_established: Whether PPO learns a successful CoinRun policy under the frozen budget.
Whether the collected trajectories improve action-conditioned dynamics.
decision: Continue the single active PPO PID under the frozen 25,165,824-transition protocol.
Do not start dynamics or any imitation-policy stage under this experiment.

Recorded the exact execution source, retained two zero-update compatibility failures, and marked the fixed-budget PPO run active after CPU and A10 smoke checks passed.
